# TASK #2 (FORAC): CHANGE OF COMMAND PERSONNEL ASSET INVENTORY (PAI)

**Affected Unit/Staff:** HHBn, 3-16 FAR, 2-82 FA, 6-56 ADAR
**NLT Dates:** 04 AUG 26
**BLUF:** Tasked units conduct PAI and report to DIVARTY when complete.

## 1. SITUATION
A Personnel Asset Inventory (PAI) is required 15 days after a company or battalion change of command.

## 2. EXECUTION

### a. Concept of Operations
NLT 15 days after a unit's Change of Command, subordinate units will conduct 100% PAI.

### b. Tasks to Subordinate Units

#### All
1. Tasked Battalions will account for all assigned and attached Soldiers.

## 3. COMMAND AND SIGNAL

### b. Signal
1. The Primary POCs for this order are CW2 Ralph Anthony at anthony.j.ralph.mil@army.mil.
